info.title: MamaAir API
info.description: Backend API for the MamaAir mobile app. Use Google sign-in or verified email/password login to obtain JWT Bearer tokens. OpenAPI examples follow the mobile E2E flow in scripts/test_server_api.py.

get.description: Returns the latest generated health insight snapshot for the authenticated user. Includes risk levels for both the mother and the baby, as well as personalized recommendations. This endpoint is typically used to populate the user's dashboard.

204.description: No health insight data available for the user.

get.description: Returns the most recent air quality and weather data based on the user's recorded exposure logs.
get.summary: Get current air quality and weather data

delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user's account from the system. This action is irreversible.

post.description: Accept Google **ID token** from Android app, verify it on the server,create or link user, and issue your JWTs (access/refresh).
Logs out the authenticated user by blacklisting the provided refresh token.
post.summary: Log out user and blacklist refresh token

post.description: Allows an authenticated user to change their password by providing the current and new password.

Takes a refresh type JSON web token and returns an access type JSON web
token if the refresh token is valid.

get.description: Returns whether the user has already checked in on the requested calendar date.
get.summary: Check whether daily checkin exists for date

post.description: Creates a daily check-in marker for one calendar date. Posting the same date twice returns a validation error because the marker is unique per user and date.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's persisted plan for their current local date, or for an optional YYYY-MM-DD date. The plan composition is created once; completion state is adapted read-only from legacy completion records.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional user-local date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

patch.description: Updates one action from the authenticated user's persisted Daily Plan. The backend maps the action UUID to its legacy task or recommendation completion record. Support actions are read-only.
patch.summary: Update a Daily Plan action completion state

get.description: Returns active task definitions ordered by `sort_order` and title. Use `code` values in task completion requests.
Returns weekly air quality exposure levels for the current user.
get.summary: Get exposure levels per pregnancy week

schema.description: Map of decimal pregnancy-week keys to weekly exposure classifications.

level.description: Exposure classification for the pregnancy week.

200.description: Object keyed by decimal pregnancy-week strings. Each present week contains a non-null exposure level. Missing weeks are omitted; users without weekly exposure records receive an empty object.

401.description: Authentication credentials were not provided or are invalid.

get.description: Returns the user's integrated exposure score history for the last N calendar days (default 7, up to 90). Missing days are simply absent from the list.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of calendar days to return (default 7, min 1, max 90).

get.description: Returns advice templates for the current user. If `week` is provided, advice can be filtered for that pregnancy week; invalid or missing values fall back to the user's current context.
Returns the user's lifestyle profile. If it does not exist yet, the backend creates an empty one. Mobile clients can safely call this before showing lifestyle onboarding fields.
get.summary: Get current user lifestyle (auto-created if missing)

patch.description: Partially updates lifestyle inputs used by risk calculations and recommendations. Choice values should be read from `GET /api/meta/choices/`.

post.description: Uploads a batch of timestamped location points for the authenticated user. The endpoint accepts `multipart/form-data` with a `file` field. CSV columns must be `latitude`, `longitude`, and `timestamp`; `timestamp` should be ISO-8601 and include a timezone when available. After import, daily exposure is recomputed for each affected calendar date.

file.description: CSV file with columns: latitude, longitude, timestamp

post.description: Uploads a batch of timestamped location points for the authenticated user as JSON. Each item in `movements` must include `latitude`, `longitude`, and ISO-8601 `timestamp`; `indoor` is optional. After import, daily exposure is recomputed for each affected calendar date. This is the preferred movement upload format for mobile clients.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile and pregnancy settings. Use this after authentication to hydrate the mobile profile/onboarding state. `bmi` is calculated from `height` and `weight_pre_pregnancy` when both are present.

put.description: Partially updates the authenticated user's profile. When `week_of_pregnancy` is changed the backend recalculates `pregnancy_start_date`. Choice values for `language`, `race`, `country`, and `preferred_share_channel` must match the API choices.

patch.description: Partially updates the authenticated user's profile. When `week_of_pregnancy` is changed the backend recalculates `pregnancy_start_date`. Choice values for `language`, `race`, `country`, and `preferred_share_channel` must match the API choices.

post.description: Uploads a profile avatar image for the authenticated user. Send multipart/form-data with an `avatar` file. Supported image types are JPEG, PNG, and WebP up to 5 MB.

delete.description: Deletes the uploaded avatar image for the authenticated user. If a legacy social avatar_url exists, profile responses will fall back to it.

get.description: Returns recommendation completion records for the authenticated user. Optional filtering by snapshot_id.

post.description: Marks one recommendation dimension as completed for a specific generated summary snapshot. The upsert key is `snapshot_id`, `rule_id`, `rule_version`, and `dimension`; posting the same key again updates `status`.
Allows the user to update their preferred interface language. This language will be used by the backend to localize responses like advice, messages, etc.
post.summary: Set preferred language for current user

get.description: Main dashboard payload for the mobile app. Returns the latest air quality/weather/UV values, current exposure, 7-day exposure history, risk delta, weekly check-in/task/water state, WHO pollutant compliance, and generated recommendations. `snapshot_id` should be stored by the client when marking a recommendation as completed.

204.description: No air exposure data available for this user yet.

get.description: Return the stable baby checklist for the user's current local day.

get.summary: Get baby selection for a date

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides recorded_at if both provided.

parameters.name: recorded_at
parameters.description: ISO-8601 datetime. If timezone omitted, interpreted in server TIME_ZONE.

post.summary: Replace baby selection for recorded_at day

get.summary: Get baby symptoms statistics by symptom class for a period

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides start_date/end_date if both are provided.

get.description: Return the stable mommy checklist for the user's current local day.

Replace all selections for the day resolved from, in priority order:
`?date=YYYY-MM-DD`, `recorded_at` in the request body or query string,
or the current date in `settings.TIME_ZONE`.
get.summary: Get mommy selection for a date

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides recorded_at if both provided.

parameters.name: recorded_at
parameters.description: ISO-8601 datetime. If timezone omitted, interpreted in server TIME_ZONE.

post.description:
Replace all selections for the day resolved from, in priority order:
`?date=YYYY-MM-DD`, `recorded_at` in the request body or query string,
or the current date in `settings.TIME_ZONE`.
post.summary: Replace mommy selection for recorded_at day

get.summary: Get mommy symptoms statistics by risk for a period

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides start_date/end_date if both are provided.

get.summary: Get mommy symptoms statistics by symptom class for a period

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides start_date/end_date if both are provided.

get.description: Returns the list of active task codes completed by the user on the requested calendar date, plus per-category done/total counts for active tasks.
get.summary: Get completed daily tasks for date

post.description: Replaces the completed task set for one calendar date. Send the full desired list of task `code` values; sending an empty list clears completions for that date. The response includes per-category done/total counts for active tasks.
post.summary: Replace completed daily tasks for date

get.description: Returns the selectable wellbeing catalog for the current user: water goal, mood chips, and feeling chips. Use the returned `id` values in `POST /api/wellbeing/log/`.
get.summary: Wellbeing catalog (water goal + mood chips + feeling chips)

get.description: Returns wellbeing state for one calendar date. If no log exists yet, the endpoint returns an empty state with `water_amount: 0`, `moods: []`, and `feelings: []`.

post.description: Updates wellbeing state for one calendar date. `water_amount` is additive: posting `250` increases the stored daily amount by 250. `mood_ids` and `feeling_ids` replace the selected chips when provided; omit a field to keep its previous selection. Answers for the user's current local date refresh recommendation inputs. If no answers are submitted, Daily Plan remains available without wellbeing-based mental actions.

DailyExposureLevelEnum.description:
* `Clean` - Clean
* `Very Good` - Very Good
* `Moderate` - Moderate
* `Acceptable` - Acceptable
* `Unhealthy` - Unhealthy
* `High` - High
* `Hazardous` - Hazardous
* `Extreme` - Extreme

id_token.description: Google ID token from Android app

HealthInsightResponse.description: OpenAPI-only contract for the existing health insight response.

LoggingTokenRefresh.description: Reject missing users and password-revoked refresh tokens without logging secrets.

RecommendationCompletionValidationError.description: Field-level validation errors returned by the completion endpoint.

SimpleExposure.description: Expose only guaranteed Exposure fields to keep the schema stable.

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601. If timezone is omitted, interpreted in server TIME_ZONE.

checklist_id.description: Optional. Older mobile clients may omit it.

TimeOfDayEnum.description:
* `morning_hours` - Morning hours
* `midday_or_afternoon` - Midday or afternoon
* `evening` - Evening
* `changes_day_to_day` - It changes day to day

TimeSpentEnum.description:
* `mostly_indoors` - Mostly indoors
* `mostly_outdoors` - Mostly outdoors
* `both_equally` - Both equally

TodayJourney.description: Serialize journey distance and the unmodified list of route points.
